objective_identity.envelope: reduction of each floor selected-input absolute peak envelope
objective_identity.each_input: each input relative to its own baseline peak meets target; stronger and separately preserved
objective_identity.selection: Do not replace/relabel one objective according to favorable results.
objective_identity.not_code_rule: Declared project objective, not a normative record-selection or averaging rule.

scope.independence: No statistical independence or general-earthquake guarantee inferred.

envelope.Pe: max over each input own frozen time grid of abs(Ve)
envelope.no_cross_input_time: No same-time force/modal sum constructed across different excitations; independent peaks only.

interval.condition: For every listed input, valid Pe in[Le,Ue] for same target/model/output scope
interval.validity: Algebra preserves conditional simultaneous validity; computed/empirical interval status is not upgraded by max.
interval.missing_input: Do not drop a missing input from a claimed complete-input envelope pass.
interval.zero_P0env: Relative improvement and normalized sensitivity undefined; report absolute force.

frozen_project_decision.engineering_pass: all target floor D_lower>=Dreq AND all widths<=Wmax AND valid data
frozen_project_decision.otherwise: one complete candidate analysis across the listed inputs under root policy
frozen_project_decision.status_separation: Preserve mathematical goal result, width status and control-input identity independently; uncertain identity alone does not force recomputation when effective interval meets policy.

baseline_directional_derivative.Pe_right_derivative: R004 max sign(Ve0[n])*Ve_zeta[n] over that input exact active temporal peaks
baseline_directional_derivative.Se: -Pe_right_derivative/Pe0, each input own baseline; denominators coincide on E0
baseline_directional_derivative.numerical_near_ties: Keep tolerance near-controlling set separate from exact E0; do not relabel exact derivative.
baseline_directional_derivative.finite_increment: Another input can take control; local Senv is not a constant finite-delta reduction factor.

comparison_proof.zero_individual_baseline: Do not silently exclude; individual relative improvement undefined, envelope may still be defined.

possible_candidate_control.overlap: identity uncertain; envelope interval still usable
possible_candidate_control.switch_hint: baseline-noncontrolling input may decline less and later dominate; keep all selected inputs.

hypothetical_example.source: independent scalar values supplied by root, not engineering data
